title: "Averages overall"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
# Summary Stats.
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpmisc)
```

## Load in the Data (filtered)

```{r}
# Loading in filtered data
filtered_data <- read.csv("data/fluxes_filtered.csv")

# Including a date variable
filtered_data$date <- as.Date(paste(filtered_data$month, "1", filtered_data$year), format = "%B %d %Y")

# Creating height variable/tree_num for graphs
filtered_data <- filtered_data |> 
  mutate(
    tree_num = str_extract(tree_id, "^[0-9]{4}"),
    height   = str_extract(tree_id, "[a-zA-Z]$"),
    height   = ifelse(is.na(height), "a", height)
  )

# Factors of month (for graphing clarity later)
filtered_data <- filtered_data |>
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.name))
```

## Filling in Columns A-J

```{r}
# Col B/C: Tree CH4 flux at standard chamber height (45 cm) (avg of all trees) (mol/m2/d)
col_b <- filtered_data |> 
  filter(height == "a") |>
  filter(surface == "stem") |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(mean_flux = mean(flux, na.rm = TRUE), sd=sd(flux))
```

```{r}
# Col D/E: Estimated average CH4 flux from entire emitting surface area of tree (based on decrease with height from 1602, 1614, 1616) (mol/m2/d)
col_d <- filtered_data |> 
  #filter(height == "a") |> 
  filter(surface == "stem") |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(mean_flux = mean(flux, na.rm = TRUE), sd=sd(flux))
```

```{r}
# Isolating trees with multiple heights for Col D/E
heights_cm <- tibble(
  height = c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e"),
  height_cm = c(45, 95, 145, 195, 345))
heights_cm


special_trees <- filtered_data |> 
  filter(tree_num %in% c(1602, 1614, 1616)) |> 
  filter(surface=="stem") |> 
  select(date, tree_num, flux, height) |> 
  left_join(heights_cm, by = "height")

special_trees |> 
  filter(date=="2013-06-01") |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=flux, y=height_cm, color=tree_num))+
  geom_point()
```

```{r}
# Col F: Emitting surface area of trees in plot (m2)*
col_f <- filtered_data |> 
  #filter(height == "a") |>
  filter(surface=="stem") |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(sum = sum(area_m2, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Col H/I: Soil CH4 flux (avg of all soil fluxes) (mol/m2/d)
col_h <- filtered_data |> 
  filter(surface=="soil") |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(mean = mean(flux, na.rm = TRUE),sd=sd(flux))
```

```{r}
# Col J: Surface area of soil in plot (total area of plot less basal area of trees + knees) (m2)*
col_j <- filtered_data |> 
  filter(surface=="soil") |> 
  group_by(date) |> 
  summarize(sum = sum(area_m2, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Plotting height and methane emissions

```{r}
# Tibble with REAL heights
heights_cm <- tibble(
  height = c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e"),
  height_cm = c(45, 95, 145, 195, 345))
heights_cm

# Joining tibble and imposing new heights
filtered_data_height <- filtered_data |> 
  filter(surface != "soil") |> 
  left_join(heights_cm, by = "height")
```

```{r}
filtered_data_height |> 
  filter(tree_num %in% c(1602, 1614, 1616)) |> 
ggplot(aes(x=flux, y=height_cm, color=tree_num)) +
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Just the median, no fractions

median_data <- filtered_data_height |>
  group_by(tree_num, height_cm) |>
  filter(tree_num %in% c(1602, 1614, 1616)) |> 
  summarize(med_flux = median(flux, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(median_data, aes(x=med_flux, y=height_cm, color=tree_num)) +
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# Fractions and median applied
median_fractions <- filtered_data_height |>
  filter(tree_num %in% c(1602, 1614, 1616)) |> 
  group_by(tree_num, height_cm) |>
  summarize(med_flux = median(flux, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(tree_num) |>
  mutate(frac_flux = med_flux / med_flux[height_cm == 45])

# Plot!
ggplot(median_fractions, aes(x = frac_flux, y = height_cm,
                        color = factor(tree_num))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_path(aes(group = tree_num)) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of flux at 45 cm",
       y = "Height above ground (cm)",
       color = "Tree") +
  theme_bw()
```


## Week of 10/14

```{r}
# Overall
month_sums <- filtered_data_height |> 
  filter(tree_num %in% c("1602", "1614", "1616")) |> 
  group_by(year, month) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_flux = mean(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_flux   = sd(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_flux  = min(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_flux  = max(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_flux = max_flux - min_flux,
    n=n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
month_sums
```

```{r}
# For height
month_sums_height <- filtered_data_height |> 
  filter(tree_num %in% c("1602", "1614", "1616")) |> 
  group_by(year, month, height) |> 
  summarize(
    mean_flux  = mean(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_flux    = sd(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_flux   = min(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_flux   = max(flux, na.rm = TRUE),
    range_flux = max_flux - min_flux,
    n          = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

high_mean <- month_sums_height |> 
  filter(mean_flux > sd_flux)

# Interesting, the months with higher means than standard deviations tend to be the warmer months of the year!
month_sums_height
high_mean
```

```{r}
# Source - https://stackoverflow.com/a/31854405
# Posted by hugot, modified by community. See post 'Timeline' for change history
# Retrieved 2026-10-21, License - CC BY-SA 4.0

t <- 1:100      # these are your time points
a <- 10         # assume the size at t = 0 is 10
r <- 0.1        # assume a growth constant
y <- a*exp(r*t) # generate some y observations from our exponential model

# visualise
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(t, y)      # on the original scale
plot(t, log(y)) # taking the log(y)

set.seed(12) # for reproducible results

# errors constant across time - additive
y_add <- a*exp(r*t) + rnorm(length(t), sd = 5000) # or: rnorm(length(t), mean = a*exp(r*t), sd = 5000)

# errors grow as y grows - multiplicative (constant on the log-scale)
y_mult <- a*exp(r*t + rnorm(length(t), sd = 1))  # or: rlnorm(length(t), mean = log(a) + r*t, sd = 1)

# visualise
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot(t, y_add, main = "additive error")
lines(t, a*exp(t*r), col = "red") 
plot(t, y_mult, main = "multiplicative error")
lines(t, a*exp(t*r), col = "red")

```

```{r}
add_nls <- nls(y_add ~ a*exp(r*t), 
               start = list(a = 0.5, r = 0.2))
coef(add_nls)

#           a           r 
# 11.30876845  0.09867135 


mult_lm <- lm(log(y_mult) ~ t)
coef(mult_lm)

# (Intercept)           t 
#  2.39448488  0.09837215 

```

## Week of 10/21

```{r}
df<-fraction1602 |>
  group_by(year, month) |>
  mutate(
    surface_area_m2     = area_m2,
    segment_flux_umol_s = surface_area_m2 * flux,
    total_tree_flux   = sum(segment_flux_umol_s),   # whole tree, all heights
    pct_of_total        = segment_flux_umol_s / sum(segment_flux_umol_s),
    multiplier_a          = if_else(
      height_cm == 45,
      1 / pct_of_total,
      NA_real_)) |>
  select(tree_num,month, year, height_cm, total_tree_flux, surface_area_m2, flux, segment_flux_umol_s, pct_of_total, multiplier_a
  )

df
```

```{r}

  geom_point()+

```
